description: Animated number stat: odometer-style rolling digits (with speed-based motion blur) count up to the value, a progress track fills in sync, the label tracks in; a soft pop when it lands. Transparent background (optional scrim).

params.value: Target number, e.g. 1250000 or 98.6 (decimals are kept as written)
params.suffix: Text after the number, e.g. '%', 'K+', ' views' (optional)
params.label: Caption under the number, e.g. 'Monthly viewers' (optional)
params.decimals: Force a number of decimals (optional; default inferred from value)
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output, default #0B0B10
